requestType.description: Specifies the action to perform on the specified subscription. You can create, modify, or delete subscriptions, based on the request type.

format.description: Specifies the format to use for notifications - XML or JSON.

creditDebitIndicator.description:
The type of transaction for which you want notifications:

* Credit 
* Debit 
* Both

accountIdentification.description: The account number associated with the subscription.

branchIdentification.description: Citi branch ID associated with the account.

fromAmount.description: The minimum amount of a transaction to trigger a notification. Notifications will not be sent for transaction amounts below this threshold.

toAmount.description: The maximium amount of a transaction to trigger a notification. Notifications will not be sent for transaction amounts above this limit.
